entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram lowering produced %s sample kind (%T), want histogram
entries.rationale: histogram-value functions call this helper only for an argument their recognizer has classified histogram-valued; lowerExpHistogramValuedShape then lowers the same argument. Its successful matched producers all publish SampleKindHistogram, so a different kind is an internal contract violation.
